title: Generate fresh hosts on the team key, sample included
action:
`onboard/templates.rs:175` `default_config()` writes `"models": {` into every freshly onboarded host's config. Change it to `"team": {`. The sample config is compiled into the binary — `templates.rs:264` `CONFIG_SAMPLE_JSON` is an `include_str!` of `.bee/config-sample.json` — so change that file's `models` key(s) to `team` in the SAME commit (the file has the key at two places, around :14 and :71; both).

Update the tests that pin these: `templates.rs:491` asserts `default_config()`'s literal key order and names `"models"`; `templates.rs:582` parses `CONFIG_SAMPLE_JSON`. Also `STALE_ADVISOR_KEY_WARNING` at `templates.rs:290` names `models.<runtime>.advisor` — make it `team.<runtime>.advisor`.

Do NOT touch this repo's own `.bee/config.json` — that flip is slice 2, after the alias is proven live. Leave `default_config()` writing `team` ONLY; never write both keys.
verify: PATH="${CARGO_HOME:-$HOME/.cargo}/bin:$PATH" cargo test --release --no-fail-fast --manifest-path packages/bee-rs/Cargo.toml --bin bee -- onboard::templates && ! rg -q '"models"' .bee/config-sample.json

truths: default_config() emits team and no models
.bee/config-sample.json carries team at every place it carried models
the key-order test and the sample-parse test pass on the new key

trace.outcome: fresh hosts are generated on the team key; the compiled-in sample and the stale-advisor warning moved with it

report.outcome: default_config() writes team instead of models (templates.rs:175); .bee/config-sample.json carries team at both places it carried models (include_str at :264 recompiles it); STALE_ADVISOR_KEY_WARNING names team.<runtime>.advisor; the key-order and sample-parse tests pass on the new key. This repo own .bee/config.json is untouched.
report.tests: cargo test --release --manifest-path packages/bee-rs/Cargo.toml --bin bee -- onboard::templates && ! rg -q "models" .bee/config-sample.json — green:unit — 6 passed 0 failed on the worker commit, run by the orchestrator; sample carries zero models keys; default_config emits team at :175
